dependency_order: A `maintenance-comment` change set seeds its scope, host identity, and anchors before the comment content, bases, and lifecycle facts that depend on them (§4.4).

slots.name: Change scope
slots.description: The change-set ID, host adapter, host file, base and proposed hashes, and the change set's one-sentence purpose.

slots.name: Change kind
slots.description: Exactly one of "added", "modified", or "removed". The kind selects the source the Anchor resolves against (Rule 4.13.3).

slots.name: Anchor
slots.description: The host file, line span, and enclosing named construct the comment attaches to: in the proposed source for an added or modified comment, and in the base source for a removed one.

slots.name: Comment text
slots.description: The exact governed comment text, with comment markers stripped. A removed comment records the text as it stood in the base source.

slots.name: Purpose
slots.description: Exactly one closed purpose from Rule 4.13.2.

slots.name: Information delta
slots.description: The knowledge deleting the comment would lose, stated against the anchored code.

slots.name: Basis
slots.description: The durable code, test, contract, work-item, or decision references that support the comment, or "None" with a reason.

slots.name: Lifecycle
slots.description: "durable", or "temporary" with the observable removal condition.

slots.name: Boundaries
slots.description: The comments, files, and conditions the change set does not cover.
